Current evidence does not add the missing RAY selective-wallet/net-accumulation confirmation, and SOL stablecoin retention remains weaker than its trading velocity. No RAY paper entry and no SOL add.

AERO is approximately $0.5751 versus the $0.5596 gross entry mark, but no new independent smart-money cohort or renewed protocol-volume acceleration was verified. The Solana/Raydium competitive development is material to monitor, not yet a reason to trim AERO.

Hyperliquid remains a major committed-capital venue and HYPE is approximately $80.79 versus the $79.35 gross entry mark. The latest whale and buyback evidence located in this run largely predates or duplicates the paper entry evidence; it is not counted as new independent confirmation. Unlock/FDV dilution risk remains the main caveat.

BSC RWA growth headlines are treated as issuance/asset-stock evidence rather than secondary trading or collateral utilization. Current chain activity does not supply the missing usage-quality confirmation, and prior incentive contamination remains relevant.

Robinhood Chain raw DEX and stablecoin metrics remain discounted because previously documented synthetic-volume/maker infrastructure and active reward programs contaminate user/volume inference. No candidate from that surface is promoted without independent funding-lineage evidence.

Arbitrum shows a potentially interesting current DEX/perp reacceleration relative to its recent average, but ARB lacks a sufficiently direct token value-capture link and no fresh selective-wallet convergence or retained-capital evidence was verified. It remains watch-only.

Portfolio NAV is approximately $9,955.61 versus passive benchmark $9,947.45, ahead by about $8.16 or 8.20 bps. The improvement versus the prior mark does not by itself constitute a trading signal. State.json and the immutable trade ledger remain unchanged.
